6.37 rsInvalidDataSourceNameLength
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
rsInvalidDataSourceNameLength is a critical error that will occur whenever the value of the Name
attribute of the DataSource is empty or is longer than 256 characters.
